0022600185.text: The Sacramento Kings (1-6, 15th in the West and 5th in the Pacific, 4.5 games back) host the Los Angeles Lakers (6-2, 1st in the Pacific) in the Kings' eighth game of the 2026-27 season, with Sacramento 0-2 at home and 1-6 over its last ten. The Lakers have won two straight and are 4-1 at home, and the teams have not met yet this season, after the Kings lost the 2025-26 series 1-3 and most recently fell 128-104 in Los Angeles on March 1, 2026. Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Daeqwon Plowden (illness), Keegan Murray (ankle) and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated), while the Lakers are missing Adou Thiero (knee inflammation).
